author: raymond91125
body:
[Written by Claude]

**Annotation to review**
- Gene product: P0A847 tgt, tRNA-guanine transglycosylase (*Escherichia coli* K-12)
- Term: GO:0008479 (tRNA-guanosine(34) queuine transglycosylase activity)
- Evidence: IDA, PMID:8323579 (Garcia et al. 1993, J Mol Biol 231:489-97), assigned by EcoCyc

**Description of issue**
GO:0008479 (tRNA-guanosine(34) queuine transglycosylase activity) now corresponds to EC 2.4.2.64 and RHEA:16633: the insertion of queuine, carried out by the eukaryotic QTRT1/QTRT2 enzyme. Bacterial Tgt inserts the precursor preQ1 instead (EC 2.4.2.29, RHEA:24104), and preQ1 is matured to queuosine later, on the tRNA.

A term for the bacterial reaction was created in geneontology/go-ontology#32883 (PR geneontology/go-ontology#32911):

- GO:7770158 (tRNA-guanosine(34) preQ1 transglycosylase activity): "Catalysis of the reaction: 7-aminomethyl-7-carbaguanine + guanosine(34) in tRNA = 7-aminomethyl-7-carbaguanosine(34) in tRNA + guanine." [PMID:7578154, RHEA:24104]

**Suggested change:** move this annotation from GO:0008479 (tRNA-guanosine(34) queuine transglycosylase activity) to GO:7770158 (tRNA-guanosine(34) preQ1 transglycosylase activity). We could only see the abstract of PMID:8323579. It describes the E. coli reaction as base exchange of guanosine-34 with preQ1, but it does not say which base the activity assays used, so please check the full text. GO:7770158 (tRNA-guanosine(34) preQ1 transglycosylase activity) was merged on 2026-11-10 and will be available from the next GO release.

The other experimental annotations EcoCyc has on tgt look unaffected: GO:0008616 (tRNA queuosine(34) biosynthetic process) and GO:0002099 (tRNA wobble guanine modification), both IMP from PMID:6804468.

Related mapping tickets for the electronic annotations to the same term: geneontology/go-annotation#6652 (UniRule) and geneontology/go-annotation#6653 (InterPro).
title: EcoCyc annotation review: E. coli tgt (P0A847) GO:0008479 to GO:7770158 (preQ1 transglycosylase)
